tags.instructions: Get coverageId from `list-coverages` and inspect `get-coverage` first. This requires MMPM. Only supplied changes are intended to change; a field can be cleared with null only where the schema permits it. Submission does not prove practice acceptance. Check any returned reconciliationId with `get-coverage-reconciliation` and verify the current record with `get-coverage` before retrying an uncertain write.

functions.name: update-medication-statement
functions.description: Submit changes to an existing medication statement's status or effective end time for practice reconciliation.

endsAt.description: Replacement effective-period end with explicit offset, or null to request clearing; cannot precede the existing start.

status.description: Replacement EMA-supported status; cannot be cleared.

changes.description: Partial mutable changes; omission preserves values and null is permitted only to request clearing the end time.

FunctionInput_modmed_updatemedicationsta.description: Submit partial status or effective-end changes to an existing medication statement.

id.description: Medication statement ID targeted by the submission.

message.description: Informational provider diagnostics; omitted if absent.

received.description: Provider acknowledged receipt of the change, not chart acceptance.

FunctionOutput_modmed_updatemedicationst.description: Acknowledgement of a medication statement change awaiting practice reconciliation.

tags.instructions: Get an ID from `list-medication-statements` or `get-medication-statement`. Only status and end time can change; medication, patient, dosage and clinical notes are immutable. Omitted fields are preserved. This is not prescribing and staff must reconcile changes.

functions.name: update-patient
functions.description: Modify selected demographic fields of an existing patient while preserving unspecified fields in the submitted resource.

patientId.description: Existing ModMed patient resource ID.

names.description: Complete replacement name collection; omitted preserves all names.

use.description: Name usage code; omitted leaves usage unspecified in this replacement name.

gender.description: Replacement gender value; unknown is an explicit value, not null.

contacts.description: Complete replacement telecom collection; [] requests clearing all telecom contacts.

rank.description: Positive preference rank; lower is preferred.

type.description: Contact medium.

birthDate.description: Replacement birth calendar date; null requests clearing it.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted fields remain unchanged in the submitted resource.

FunctionInput_modmed_updatepatient.description: Identify an existing patient and the selected demographic changes to submit.

patientId.description: Patient resource ID targeted by the update.

submitted.description: Provider accepted the update request; use Get patient for current demographics.

updatedAt.description: Resource last-update instant only if explicitly returned by the provider, normalized to UTC.

FunctionOutput_modmed_updatepatient.description: Provider acceptance of the patient update, not a guarantee of unchanged persistence.

tags.instructions: Obtain patientId from `list-patients` and inspect `get-patient` before editing. Use `create-patient` only for a genuinely new patient. Supplied names or contacts replace those collections; omitted changes preserve them. Clearing uses null only where allowed. An uncertain write should be checked with `get-patient` before retrying.

functions.name: update-task
functions.description: Change an EMA task's priority, assignees, attachments, notes, or optional encounter, requester, and lab-order references while preserving immutable fields. PM recalls and task lifecycle status cannot be changed.

notes.description: Complete replacement note collection; [] clears notes and omission preserves them. All times must be present or all absent, and non-decreasing.

text.description: Ordinary note text, including empty text.

time.description: Optional explicit-offset instant, normalized losslessly to UTC before submission.

authorId.description: Optional practitioner author identifier for this replacement note.

items.description: A replacement task note with optional author and explicit-offset time.

taskId.description: Existing EMA Task identifier including TASK| prefix; PMRECALL IDs are not editable.

priority.description: Replacement priority; omission preserves current priority and null is not accepted.

assignees.description: Complete replacement assignee collection; omission preserves it. At least one assignee must remain.

id.description: Opaque practitioner or CareTeam identifier, retaining provider prefixes.

kind.description: Individual practitioner or staff-group resource kind.

label.description: Free-text role label; empty text is preserved.

items.description: A replacement assignee and its role label.

encounterId.description: Replacement encounter identifier; null clears the association and omission preserves it.

requesterId.description: Replacement requester practitioner identifier; omission preserves it. Clearing requester is not exposed.

attachedDocumentIds.description: Complete replacement document attachment IDs; [] clears documents and omission preserves them.

items.description: Opaque identifier of an attached DocumentReference.

basedOnServiceRequestIds.description: Complete replacement lab-order identifiers within this firm; [] clears associations and omission preserves them.

items.description: Opaque identifier of a lab-order ServiceRequest within this firm.

FunctionInput_modmed_updatetask.description: Editable changes to an existing EMA task; provide taskId and at least one change.

id.description: Provider-confirmed identifier of the updated EMA task.

updatedAt.description: Provider top-level lastModified instant normalized to UTC Z, if supplied.

FunctionOutput_modmed_updatetask.description: Provider-confirmed update receipt; use get-task for the resulting task state.

tags.instructions: Get taskId from `list-tasks` or `get-task`. Only EMA TASK IDs are editable. Supply only fields to change; supplied arrays replace their corresponding collections. Empty notes/documents/lab-order arrays clear those collections; encounterId null clears the encounter. At least one assignee must remain. Description, patient, location, creation time and status cannot be changed. Re-read with `get-task` before retrying an uncertain write because intervening edits and secondary effects are possible.

functions.name: upload-document-from-staged-url
functions.description: Submit a document already uploaded to ModMed's staging S3 URL into EMA, optionally associated with a patient, a practice document category, Results Log, or the Patient Reported Outcomes module.

title.description: Ordinary document title; omitted if not supplied and empty text is literal.

filename.description: Original filename, supplied as ordinary Unicode text.

patientId.description: Patient to associate; omission intentionally sends the document to the practice's unassociated queue.

sizeBytes.description: Actual uploaded file size in bytes, if known.

stagedUrl.description: ModMed-issued S3 staging URL containing an already-uploaded file; not an arbitrary source URL. Generated staging URLs expire after five minutes.

contentType.description: Actual document MIME type, for example application/pdf; no file-content conversion is performed.

destination.description: EMA business destination. Results Log requires a practice Results category code; PROS uses the documented PROS category.

encounterId.description: Optional encounter association for the document.

categoryCode.description: Practice-specific document-category code; required for results-log, optional for attachments, and not used for PROS. Obtain from the practice's document-category ValueSet or administrator.

practitionerId.description: Optional related Practitioner identifier, especially for PRO submissions.

originalCreatedAt.description: Original file creation instant with explicit offset, used for EMA's Original Creation Date rather than upload time.

FunctionInput_modmed_uploaddocumentfroms.description: Metadata and destination for one document already uploaded to ModMed staging.

id.description: Document reference ID only if explicitly returned by ModMed.

message.description: Informational provider diagnostics; omitted if absent.

received.description: ModMed acknowledged the document submission; not a claim of clinical review, signing or recipient delivery.

FunctionOutput_modmed_uploaddocumentfrom.description: Provider acknowledgement of the final document submission, without downstream review claims.

stagingUrlPrefix.description: Trusted ModMed staging origin and practice-specific path prefix ending in /, provisioned for this connection environment.

resultsCategoryCodes.description: Practice-verified document-category codes whose display starts with Results -.

tags.instructions: The file must already exist at a ModMed-issued staging S3 URL; this tool does not stage bytes or accept arbitrary remote files. Choose a practice category code for attachments or Results Log, or destination patient-reported-outcomes for PROS. Omit patientId only intentionally: the document goes to the practice's unassociated queue. Use `list-documents` to check patient-associated receipt before repeating an uncertain write.
